newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed prices slide,poor overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed prices slide,poor overseas demand.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Friday slid by 2/3 rupees at 1,138/1,139 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative selling, traders said.
"Sluggish overseas demand and higher supplies prompted fresh offerings," one trader said.
Daily average arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained high at 8,000/10,000 bags (75 kg each).
"However some traders were expecting these arrivals to fall in coming days. Prices may bounce back," one operator said.

Groundnut oil was quiet at 362/363 rupees per 10 kg amid limited inflows of 40/50 tonnes. Local demand too remained at a low ebb. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil fell by five rupees at 565 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay imported palm oil slid by 1/2 rupees at 257 rupees per 10 kg as losses in the world market triggered offerings by local importers.
"Sentiment is weak and palm oil prices may go down further," one importer said.
